text_block_list.text:
The day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
Passing by the grandstands before the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is coming up 
soon~! I've been looking forward to it so 
much~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! Above all, the main 
highlight is... the "Princess Showdown"! 
After all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Lady Fine Motion! I'm sure she'd give 
the most wonderful wave. So royal~!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Kawakami Princess-san will 
surely make a princess-like entrance! 
...Probably!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... This is shaping up to be a truly 
graceful race...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ... Lovely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tell Fine for me. Tell her not to show me 
such half-baked running.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I bet she'll just smirk carelessly like 
always, yet still put the sheer difference 
in our abilities on full display."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And... it'll all come to an "end." I came 
here to see that for myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...You'd better make it worth what I paid 
for the bullet train ticket."

Even Air Shakur is keeping an eye on this 
year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let's get gutsy~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sheer guts~!
(Murmur...)
A tumultuous start to the show!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Fine-san, would you look at that? 
Everyone is so full of excitement!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Kawakami-chan. So this is 
how a Japanese-style princess does things.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I have been eagerly looking 
forward to this day.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Because facing you is truly nothing short 
of a dream... A veritable dream match!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Dream Match!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this! I challenge 
you fair and square to a head-on battle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Fine-san!! I am going to take you down!!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...This is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wh-What's wrong?! Please don't 
actually collapse on me~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My chest feels all restless, like even the 
tiny hairs on my skin are standing up.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Your declaration of war... sends chills 
through me. Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew. Oh, is that all it was?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's simple! Fine-san just wants to beat 
the living daylights out of me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Your fighting spirit is burning bright! As 
your rival, I am honored!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Me, having a competitive spirit...?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm sorry, Fine. However, I must be 
going now.”

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘My companion awaits ahead on that stage. 
More than anything, my heart screams— that 
I want to compete with her, that I want to 
win!’"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: “Goodbye, Fine... I'm so sorry—”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't do that... Because if you 
learn that...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Because I will become the 
"foundation"...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
? I don't really get it, but running it 
all will make it clear!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san! All you need to do is come at 
me with everything you've got!"
